name: Dr. Russell Chang
bio:
For over 40 years, Dr. Russell Chang has been the trusted name in orthodontic care for families throughout Los Alamitos and the surrounding communities. As a Diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics and an Adjunct Assistant Professor of Postdoctoral Orthodontics at USC, Dr. Chang brings an exceptional depth of clinical expertise and academic rigor to every patient he treats — combining decades of hands-on experience with the latest advancements in orthodontic technology.

Alongside Dr. Christine Chung, USC Adjunct Assistant Professor of Pediatric Dentistry, Dr. Chang leads a practice built on a singular philosophy: that every smile deserves thoughtful, personalized care. Together, they craft what the practice proudly calls Chang Smiles — beautiful, lasting results achieved through the highest standards of treatment, delivered in the most efficient and streamlined time possible.

Whether you're a child visiting for the first time or an adult exploring your options, you'll find a warm, welcoming environment where precision meets genuine compassion. Dr. Chang's commitment to this community spans generations, and that legacy of trust is something the entire Chang Orthodontics team works to honor every single day.
